examples: “Are you coming to the game?” “You bet!”
entries.position: front — before a clause, or alone as a reply
entries.contrast: Informal and very American. As a reply to Thanks, it means you're welcome: “Thanks for the ride.” “You bet.” It has nothing to do with gambling.

entries.meaning: With great energy and devotion to a cause or duty.
examples: The new manager enforced the rules zealously.
Lawyers must represent their clients zealously.
entries.modifies: verbs of guarding, defending, enforcing and pursuing
